items.title: Animal-origin-free medium enhances G2/M progression while maintaining identity and genomic stability in human adipose-derived MSCs
items.finding: Across three adipose MSC donors and early to late passages, an animal-origin-free medium gave the shortest doubling time versus serum and serum-free media, enriched G2/M cell-cycle programs, and kept ISCT identity markers and copy number stability.

items.title: Off-the-shelf cryopreserved adipose tissue and ADSCs accelerate epithelial regeneration
items.finding: Adipose-derived stem cells stored for two months at -80 C closed rat wounds faster than cryopreserved adipose tissue or controls by day 3 (about 65% vs 54% vs 43%), with similar trends in ex vivo human skin.

items.title: Identification and Functional Characterization of CDK1, CCNB1, CCNB2, RRM2, and GTSE1 Associated with Replicative Senescence of Human Umbilical Cord-Derived Mesenchymal Stem Cells
items.finding: Five cell-cycle genes (CDK1, CCNB1, CCNB2, RRM2, GTSE1) rose with passage in UC-MSCs across four donors alongside classic senescence features at passage 12, though the authors say causality is not established.

items.title: Synergistic reversal of mesenchymal stem cell senescence by engineered exosomal delivery of a dual miR-195/miR-188 sponge
items.finding: Wharton's jelly MSC exosomes loaded with a miR-195/miR-188 sponge lowered p16, p53, IL-6, ROS and beta-gal in replicatively senescent adipose MSCs and were linked to restored telomere length and clonogenic capacity.

items.title: Bioreactor cultures of brain endothelial cells produce extracellular vesicles with comparable characteristics as that of batch cultures
items.finding: A CELLine AD1000 bioreactor kept brain endothelial cells about 90% viable for up to eight weeks and gave three to four times more EV protein than flasks, with comparable particle properties, mitochondrial cargo and ATP rescue.

items.title: TriPort tangential flow filtration: a lab-assembled system for EV isolation across diverse cell-culture sources
items.finding: A lab-built, lower-cost tangential flow filtration rig reproducibly isolated EVs from three culture sources, and adding size-exclusion chromatography mattered most for serum-containing media, where TFF alone co-concentrated serum proteins.

items.title: Cytokine priming shifts mitochondrial architecture and extracellular vesicle cargo of feline placental mesenchymal stromal cells toward an immunosuppressive phenotype
items.finding: In placental MSCs from seven cats, priming with TNF-alpha, IFN-gamma, IL-1 and IL-6 kept viability above 96%, elongated mitochondria and shifted EV cargo toward anti-inflammatory miRNAs such as miR-204 and let-7g.

items.title: Mesenchymal stem cell-derived extracellular vesicles modulate Th1- and STAT1-associated inflammatory responses in peripheral blood mononuclear cells from patients with osteoarthritis
items.finding: MSC EVs (20 ug per million PBMCs, 48 h) cut Th1 cell frequency in PBMCs from 10 osteoarthritis patients from about 34% to 27% and lowered STAT1, IL-1 beta, IL-6 and TNF-alpha.

items.title: Integrated evaluation of umbilical cord mesenchymal stromal cell-derived extracellular vesicles across skin-related cellular and zebrafish models
items.finding: One defined UC-MSC EV preparation reduced oxidative injury in keratinocytes, lowered UVB-induced fibroblast senescence and raised zebrafish fin regeneration from about 60% to 84% at 48 hours.

items.title: Phase IIa Trial of Locoregional High-Dose Autologous Natural Killer Cell Therapy Combined with Hepatic Arterial Infusion Chemotherapy for Locally Advanced Hepatocellular Carcinoma
items.finding: In 16 evaluable patients with refractory locally advanced liver cancer, hepatic arterial autologous NK infusion after HAIC gave an independently assessed response rate of about 69% and median overall survival of 24 months, with no severe NK-related toxicity.

items.title: Fibrinogen depletion prevents non-dissociable cell aggregates of feeder-derived NK cell products
items.finding: Macroscopic aggregates in feeder-expanded NK products came from feeder cells plus plasma fibrinogen together, and swapping autologous plasma for a fibrinogen-free serum substitute prevented them without hurting expansion, viability or killing.

items.title: Functional Exhaustion Limits CAR-NK Therapy in Glioblastoma but Can Be Mitigated by Early Repeated Dosing
items.finding: B7H3 CAR-NK cells killed glioblastoma faster than CAR-T in vitro but lost function after repeated tumor challenge and failed in mice, while early repeated dosing, not TGF-beta or IL-15 engineering, improved survival.

items.title: PTPN22 as a novel therapeutic target: a key intracellular checkpoint for NK cell therapy
items.finding: Deleting or inhibiting PTPN22 boosted NK and CAR-NK killing and cytokine release, preserved function under TME-like cytokine stress, and prolonged survival in a leukemia xenograft.

items.title: Targeting HLA-E-NKG2A/CD94 to reverse pyroptosis-induced immunosuppression in HCC enhances NK cell antitumor activity
items.finding: NK killing caused tumor pyroptosis and IL-10 release that pushed macrophages to an HLA-E-high M2 state, which suppressed NK cells through NKG2A, and blocking that axis restored NK activity in vitro and in mice.

items.title: Decline of chaperone-mediated autophagy in aging impairs macrophage clearance of senescent cells
items.finding: Age-related loss of chaperone-mediated autophagy made senescent cells more aged-like and their SASP blocked macrophage clearance, while drug activation of CMA cut senescent cell burden in old mice and eased lung fibrosis.

items.title: uPAR-Targeting T Cell Engager Exerts Senolytic Effects in Mice and Non-Human Primates With Serum Aminotransferase Activity as a Safety Monitor
items.finding: A uPAR-directed T cell engager cleared senescent cells and eased age-related pathology in aged mice and monkeys at low dose, while high doses caused liver toxicity that serum transaminases flagged.

items.title: Methylation-associated Gene Expression (MaGE): a non-invasive, in vivo measure of cellular senescence
items.finding: Blood DNA methylation proxies for p16, p21 and p14ARF expression, tested in 18,859 people, showed 45 significant links to 18 incident diseases and mortality and tracked treatment response in Crohn's disease.

items.title: Chronic Senolytic Treatment and/or Aerobic Exercise Reduce Senescence and Improve Myocardial Function During Aging in the Heart
items.finding: Nine months of dasatinib plus quercetin, aerobic exercise, or both in middle-aged mice lowered p16+, p21+ and gamma-H2AX+ heart cells and improved diastolic function, with no clear added benefit from combining them.
